sites.name: eLeaseReturns.com
sites.notes: Dealer Car Search platform (dealercarsearch.com assets, dealer id 3073) — confirmed by control fetch (SRP pages + one live VDP) that it emits zero schema.org Vehicle/ItemList JSON-LD anywhere, and VDP URLs use numeric internal ids (/vdp/{id}/...) not VINs, so our sitemap/VIN-prefilter + JSON-LD pipeline has no hook into this platform at all. A real discovery gap, not a bug: VIN is only recoverable via raw-HTML field scraping (scattered hidden form inputs), not one embedded blob like DDC/DealerOn/TeamVelocity, so a dedicated extractor would be substantial new work. Also: canonical link and robots.txt Sitemap: both point to leasereturns.com (no 'e' prefix) — eleasereturns.com looks like an alias domain serving identical content. Sampled current inventory (~2 dozen VDPs across SRP pages) shows no EVs in stock right now (BMW, Land Rover, other luxury ICE) — today's zero yield is doubly correct, but the platform gap would still miss any EV they do carry later. | probe 2026-08-13: 0 VIN vehicles in 12 fetches (0 ItemList entries, platform dealercarsearch) — likely needs a platform extractor | probe 2026-08-13: 0 VIN vehicles in 12 fetches (0 ItemList entries, platform dealercarsearch) — likely needs a platform extractor | dealercarsearch extractor 2026-08-16: 2 pages with vehicle records in 3 fetches, 1 EV(s) admitted; SRP walk complete (truncated=false)

sites.notes: Discovered via Common Crawl dealer-platform URL fingerprint sweep (CC-MAIN-2026-30), 2026-08-17 — site serves inventory paths matching a platform we extract | auto-promoted by probe 2026-08-17: 1 VIN vehicles on 1 page(s), platform dealeron | diagnosed 2026-08-20 from the ID. Buzz coverage audit (docs/agents/coverage-audit-2026-08-20.md), which flagged this rooftop as registered-but-still-missing: the bare apex mosesvolkswagen.com serves a TLS cert for *.dealeron.com, not itself (ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID on a direct connection) — page fetches survive because fetchPage()'s www/apex retry (lib/http.mjs) papers over it, but the DealerOn API call in lib/platforms/dealeron-api.mjs builds its URL from crawl.mjs's `origin` (crawl.mjs:110, always the bare domain) with no equivalent www fallback, so pullLot() throws on every call and the crawl falls back to the slow HTML/ItemList walk, which then bails at the NO_EV_FLOOR (0 EVs in 40 pages) before ever reaching the cars this dealer does list. Diagnosis-only, not a registry fix: switching this row's domain to www.mosesvolkswagen.com would dodge the cert but changes dealerDomain identity for every existing listing/price-history row keyed to the bare domain, which is out of scope for a registry curation pass. Confirmed independently (crawl.mjs www.mosesvolkswagen.com, not committed) that the API works fine over www and the site's full 161-vehicle inventory (94 used + 67 new, complete pull) is 100% gasoline/hybrid — zero EVs or PHEVs on the lot as of 2026-08-20, so even a fixed crawl would not find the Buzz the audit inferred here; either it already sold or the audit's WV-level inference pointed at the wrong specific rooftop.
